ownRead.statement:
## E20 — Self-replicating segregation patterns in horizontally vibrated binary mixture of granules

**experiment · partial bridge · claims C3, C4, C5.**

**Reported result:** A shaken granular mixture develops bands that reproduce; segregation and flow/fluidity feedback participate in the dynamics.

**Already supplied:** Two grain populations, a container and continued horizontal shaking are supplied.

**Limit of the RRG connection:** This connects vibration, organization and pattern multiplication without biological copying machinery. It does not establish successive independent scales.

**Source:** Ebata & Inagaki (2024), *Scientific Reports 14, 5329*. [DOI: 10.1038/s41598-024-55876-y](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-024-55876-y).

**Verification coverage:** Publisher HTML. Supplementary materials were not independently reproduced. Checked 2026-10-02. Shares an author with E11; these are different systems, not independent replications of a single result.
